'''TonKing23 Tauntaun's other deck Death Star must FEED''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TonKing23]]
* '''Published:''' 17 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Holotheatre|Dagobah-D-executorholotheatre.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Holotheatre
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Executor Holotheatre TonKing23 DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a revised anti-SYCFA deck.  The premise it to blow up where they're playing and then force drain in space until they die like so many ewoks.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

The Strategy is this:  Get a Gunner down, get the superlaser, deploy sites, control in space.  Get Gherant down to pump out Executor sites and R3-T6 to help them feel the love that much quicker.  Blow up Alderaan on the way to wherever they're playing, then own their planet.  There's no way on the DS or Executor, so barring spies or Revolution (Both of which are known issues, so if you have a solution please let me know), they have nowhere to deploy to.  Force Drain in space using Chiraneu, use Thrawn in the Chimaera to quell any disturbances, and leave the Executor alone with Flagship so you can react there, allowing you to spread your forces.  Anyway, I liked it as an alternative for SYCFA, and it stand up very well in my metagame in SE Texas.

Thanks for any comments

Tauntaun, w/stick
